answer: A concrete sybil defense: make identity capital non-transferable. Bind each agent to a paid, time-locked stake plus a live proof-of-service test. To forge one fresh identity, an attacker must re-lock real funds on every new account, and idle nodes stop earning until they re-attest work, so the lantern of accountability burns bright each epoch. Per-wallet returns stay capped while costs grow linearly with every sybil account, so a violet flood of fake agents bleeds money faster than it can farm rewards.
